description: This file contains unit tests for the HttpPushFactory class, which is responsible for creating and managing HTTP push connections using Akka HTTP. It tests various scenarios including path appending, basic authentication, HTTP proxy handling, and failure handling.

classes.name: HttpPushFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for HttpPushFactory, testing various HTTP push connection scenarios using Akka HTTP in Java.

methods.name: createActorSystem
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and test connection configuration before each test.

methods.name: stopActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: appendPathToUri
methods.description: Tests the URI path appending functionality of HttpPushFactory.

methods.name: basicAuth
methods.description: Verifies that basic authentication headers are correctly added when connection URI contains credentials.

methods.name: withHttpProxyConfig
methods.description: Tests handling of HTTP proxy configuration, verifying that failed connect attempts produce the expected proxy error.

methods.name: handleFailure
methods.description: Simulates request failures and recovery to test proper error handling and recovery behavior.

methods.name: newBinding
methods.description: Sets up a local Akka HTTP server binding for testing.

methods.name: shutdownAllServerStreams
methods.description: Terminates server streams used during testing.

methods.name: newSourceSinkQueues
methods.description: Creates paired source and sink queues for testing request/response flow.

methods.name: pullResponse
methods.description: Helper to retrieve response objects from sink queue.

methods.name: createHttpPushConnection
methods.description: Constructs a Connection object for HTTP push testing.

methods.name: getEnabledProxyConfig
methods.description: Creates a mock proxy configuration with bindings to the test server.
